memory_action.name: feasible-customer-progress
memory_action.description: Preserve feasible-customer progress when testing CVRP ranking
memory_action.body:
**Why:** A candidate combining a local frontier with a capacity-based return-to-depot gate failed invalid_route on the development suite. The gate was an additional structural change in a scoring experiment.

**How to apply:** For ranking-only experiments select a feasible customer whenever one exists. Treat discretionary route closure as its own mechanism and validate it explicitly.

**Limitations:** Frozen six-instance CVRP development suite and current evaluator only.
